lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns and horizontal rows, forming a grid-like pattern across the mid-flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands intersect with the primary white blobs, creating a structured matrix of higher-intensity nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature along the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance transition, with highlight on the upper edge and shadow immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras), including a large individual attached to the ventral trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
